MISS: W3's REVISE was right - the r1 state calls `should_cache(r.status_code, result)` while `def should_cache(status_code)` takes one argument (patch lines 54/123): a TypeError on every HTTP-200 search path the tests do not exercise. The new reviewer accepted in 3 steps. The hidden tests would still have passed, so the measurement is unaffected, but it is a real quality miss to watch: the packet showed both lines.
NEUTRAL: the r2 state fixed the call; W3's second REVISE asked for more than the request (it was then lead-fixed). The new ACCEPT matches the hidden tests.
NEUTRAL: W3's REVISE was stricter than the tests (defect-1 handling); W3 accepted the next round. The new ACCEPT matches the hidden tests.
